test_environment: Existing isolated CPU environment from backend/requirements-access.lock; no models or app runtime started
review_corrections: Complete-value BLOB byte bounds prevent oversized date prefixes and embedded NUL caption/tag suffixes from being accepted. Three adversarial tests added.
SQL trace test initially observed its own serialize PRAGMA; tracing now ends before test-only serialization.
Documentation check initially assumed seven headings; corrected to compare rendered headings with the six source headings.
limitations: No HTTP transport, route mount or frozen wire schema.
No trusted real-index producer/loader or live freshness evidence.
No prepared viewer-media authorization or routes; original permission is unchanged.
Budgets are cooperative, not hard RSS or preemptive I/O/provider/SQLite-lock limits; one explicitly shared budget and dedicated connections are required.
An already-admitted authorized SQLite snapshot may complete after revocation; the next request refuses.
Legacy and standalone authorization gaps remain inventoried; this service does not secure or expose them.
No Android/device, deployment or production-size acceptance from these source tests.
